facts.fact: L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, says intra-UEMOA e-money transfers made up 5.63% of the value of Mali's mobile money transactions in 2024.
L'Oeil du Sahel, citing BCEAO 2024 data, puts intra-UEMOA transfers at 5.63% of the value of Mali's 18,744,827 million FCFA of e-money transactions in 2024.
